monthly_formula: ratio=final_equity/100; duration_years=(complete_evaluation_until - folds[0][0])/(365.2425*86400) per configs/swing_v15_continuous_folds.json; monthly_geometric_net=ratio^(1/(12*duration_years))-1; annual=ratio^(1/duration_years)-1

control_reference.note: Control pool_1x rerun (full 326-signal pool, 1x, normal) MUST reproduce total_return/max_drawdown within 1e-9 AND exact trades/signals, else STOP. Control is verification only, NOT a counted branch.

s0004_reference.note: s0004 reference: expect approx +190.84%/101 fills normal. Record match (tol 1e-9 + exact trades/signals); mismatch is RECORDED, not fatal (unlike control).

dd_guard_conditional.rule: Run dd_guard ONLY on the best NON-s0004 session branch (highest normal monthly_geometric_net among s0408/s0812/s1216/s1620/s2024 with n_signals>0) AND ONLY IF its normal monthly strictly beats the reproduced control normal monthly. Else SKIP + record reason. Never guard s0004 (reference leg). Not a pre-spec branch; output <best>_dd_guard/ if run.
dd_guard_conditional.reference: control_1x equity of THIS experiment (pool rerun, past-only, 1-microsecond cutoff, seed 100.0)
dd_guard_conditional.formula: At each guarded signal time ts: past = control exits strictly before ts; lev = 0.5 if level/peak < 0.9 else 1.0.
dd_guard_conditional.execution: ExecutionConfig(leverage=0.25, max_leverage=1.0) + per-signal leverage column 0.5/1.0 kept in signals (keep-column v49 convention; engine reads per-signal leverage; record guard fraction).

causality: past-only closed-candle; session is a pure function of frozen signal_time UTC hour (inherently causal, no future info); guard from strictly-past control exits; fills from next candle onward.
engine_note: ohlc-v2: limit entry from next candle, expiry 12 bars (from dataset config), holding cap 2016 bars, stop-first intrabar, TP suppression on intrabar entry candle, stop/timeout market-like at scenario fee, funding long 0.0001/8h short 0, compounding from current equity, drawdown trade-candle-close sampled (not true mark/full-intrabar). No maker fill/queue claims from OHLC.
